executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 45 errors due to missing critical dependencies. The same dependency issues from attempt 1 persist: Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not available. Additionally, UserTaskController now also shows missing Spring Data domain imports.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security dependencies: packages org.springframework.security.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Security starter dependency is still missing from pom.xml after attempt 1. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages for HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity annotations.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA dependencies: packages org.springframework.data.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA starter dependency remains missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) and controllers (TaskManagementController, UserTaskController) require Spring Data JPA packages for JpaRepository, Page, Pageable, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence dependency: package jakarta.persistence does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is still not available. Entity class BoardColumn requires JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, @GeneratedValue, @ManyToOne, @JoinColumn) which are part of jakarta.persistence package.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml as it transitively includes jakarta.persistence-api.

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3 dependency: package org.apache.commons.lang3 does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library remains missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils class requires StringUtils or other utilities from commons-lang3.

summary: 4 dependency errors found causing 45 compilation failures
